'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Operation Allies Refuge]]
***[[Spokesperson for the United States Department of State|U.S. Department of State spokesperson]] [[Ned Price]] announces that 23,876 [[Afghan refugees]] have arrived in the [[United States]]. He also says that the efforts did not end on August 31 and that [[Americans]] who are still in Afghanistan will be provided with "tailored" evacuation plans. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/09/01/23876-at-risk-afghans-have-already-arrived-in-the-united-states.html (CNBC)] [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/afghanistan-stranded-tailored-evacuation-routes (Fox News)]
***[[U.S. Ambassador to Afghanistan]] [[Ross Wilson (ambassador)|Ross Wilson]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]] following [[2021 evacuation from Afghanistan|the evacuation]] from Afghanistan. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/09/01/us-diplomat-kabul-evacuation-tests-positive-covid-508382 (Politico)]
**[[Panjshir conflict]]
***[[Taliban]] senior member [[Amir Khan Muttaqi]] says that the group has now surrounded the [[Panjshir Valley]], the last stronghold of anti-Taliban resistance, and calls for the rebels to "put down their weapons" saying that the Taliban wants an Islamic Emirate for all Afghans and adding that there is "no need to fight". The [[National Resistance Front of Afghanistan]] is led by self-proclaimed president [[Amrullah Saleh]] and [[Ahmad Massoud]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-says-it-has-surrounded-afghan-resistance-fighters-calls-peace-2021-09-01/ (Reuters)]
**Aftermath of the [[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan]]
***The Taliban holds a military parade in the [[Afghanistan]] city of [[Kandahar]] showing equipment used by the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]]. A [[Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk|Black Hawk]] helicopter is also shown at the parade. [https://www.businessinsider.com/photos-taliban-military-parade-shows-off-captured-weapons-of-war-2021-9 (''Business Insider'')]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Allied Democratic Forces|ADF]] militants [[ambush]] a convoy carrying civilians in eastern [[Democratic Republic of Congo]], killing four people and kidnapping dozens more. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/scores-feared-missing-after-ambush-eastern-congo-2021-09-01/ (Reuters)]
*Seventy-three children are abducted by armed men at a rural secondary school in [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]]. The government of Zamfara State has closed all public schools in order to prevent similar attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/many-children-feared-abducted-school-northwest-nigeria-2021-09-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
**It is reported that [[India's economy]] rebounded at a record rate of 20.1% in the three months from April to June despite being devastated by a second wave of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-58390291 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Ida]]
***[[Governor of New Jersey|New Jersey Governor]] [[Phil Murphy]] announces a [[state of emergency]] due to widespread flooding from Ida's remnants. In [[New York City]], a flash flood emergency warning is declared for the first time. [https://www.nj.com/weather/2021/09/nj-weather-gov-phil-murphy-declares-state-of-emergency-due-to-widespread-flooding-storm-damage-from-ida-remnants.html (NJ.com)] [https://abcnews.go.com/US/idas-remnants-deluge-york-jersey-flooding-rain-tornadoes/story?id=79780365 (ABC News)]
***The death toll from Ida reaches six after two [[Alabama]] [[Electrician|electricity workers]] are killed while repairing [[power lines]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hurricane-ida-death-count-rescue-damage/ (CBS News)]
***The upcoming [[2021 New Orleans Saints season|New Orleans Saints]] matchup against the [[2021 Green Bay Packers season|Green Bay Packers]] will be moved from [[New Orleans]] to [[Jacksonville, Florida|Jacksonville]]'s [[TIAA Bank Field]] following damage from Ida. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/nicholasreimann/2021/09/01/saints-packers-game-moving-to-jacksonville-after-hurricane-ida-wrecks-new-orleans/?sh=4835aebf18d5 (Forbes)]
*An oil spill that originated from [[Petroleum industry in Syria|Syria's largest refinery]] continues to spread across the [[Mediterranean Sea]], potentially reaching [[Cyprus]] by Wednesday. [[Syrian Government|Syrian officials]] report that a tank containing 15,000 tonnes of fuel began to leak on August 23 in [[Baniyas]] while [[satellite imagery]] indicates that the spill covers an area of around 800 square kilometers and is approximately {{convert|7|km|miles}} from the [[Cyprus (island)|Cypriot coast]]. [https://www.9news.com.au/world/syrian-oil-spill-spreads-across-the-mediterranean-and-could-reach-cyprus/51c5686e-ad53-4437-b6f7-76a2dd4e2316 (9 News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
*****Over 2.4 million children in [[Israel]] return to school on the start of the new academic year with mandatory [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask]]s and [[COVID-19 testing]] aimed at reducing an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in the highly-vaccinated country primarily caused by the highly transmissible [[Delta variant]]. [https://www.israeltoday.co.il/read/school-begins-under-the-shadow-of-covid/ (Israel Today)] [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/09/01/Israel-starts-new-school-year-as-COVID-19-cases-surge (Al-Arabiya English)]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
*****The head of Israel's Biological Institute, Professor Shmuel Shapira, reveals that midway through vaccine development, its office was requested by the government of then-[[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to suspend development of a locally developed [[vaccine]]. [https://www.ynetnews.com/magazine/article/byemibz11k (Ynet News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Japan]]
*****[[Moderna]], the [[Takeda Pharmaceutical Company]], and [[Spain|Spanish]] drug maker Rovi issue a joint statement indicating that they have found particles of [[stainless steel]] in some [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] vials, but that the particles did not pose any additional health risks. The companies also state that they are working with the [[Government of Japan|Japanese government]] to recall three suspended batches of the vaccine. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/japan-finds-stainless-steel-particles-suspended-doses-moderna-vaccine-2021-09-01/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] surpasses five million cases of [[COVID-19]] after reporting 33,170 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://en.trend.az/iran/society/3477342.html (Trend News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] reports a record 3,726 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 217,546. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/health/mongolia-reports-record-daily-count-of-covid-1340107.html (UrduPoint)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oman]]
****[[Oman]] restricts the entry of public and private establishments as well as attendance of cultural, sports, and other group events to only those who have been [[COVID-19 vaccination in Oman|vaccinated]] against COVID-19. The country is also mandating two doses of any government-approved [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] for travelers who want to enter the country. [https://timesofoman.com/article/106163-only-vaccinated-people-can-enter-public-private-establishments-in-oman (''Times of Oman'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/philippines-hits-2-million-virus-cases-as-delta-drives-surge (Radio France Internationale)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom]]
*****The [[Joint Committee on Vaccination and Immunisation]] announces a recommendation that 500,000 people with severe [[immunosuppression]] should receive a third dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2021/09/01/half-million-vulnerable-get-third-covid-vaccine-dose-jcvi-announces/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in France]]
*****[[France]] begins to administer [[booster dose]]s of the COVID-19 vaccine to people over the age of 65 and people with underlying health conditions, provided that they have received both doses of either the [[Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer]] or [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] vaccine at least six months ago. People who received the single-dose [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine|Janssen]] vaccine can also receive a booster dose of either of the two other vaccines at least four weeks after they first received a vaccine. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/09/01/france-starts-giving-covid-booster-jabs-to-its-elderly-and-vulnerable (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Spain]]
*****[[Spain]] reaches a target of fully vaccinating 70% of the population. [https://english.elpais.com/society/2021-08-31/spain-about-to-hit-70-covid-vaccination-target-despite-slower-pace.html (''El País'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****[[Andorra]] begins administering booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccine to the most vulnerable groups. [https://www.europapress.es/catalunya/andorra-01111/noticia-andorra-empieza-administrar-tercera-dosis-vacuna-covid-19-mas-vulnerables-20210901185728.html (Europa Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] expands the mandatory usage of "Green Pass" health certificates to some forms of public transport, including long-distance trains, domestic flights and ferries. The pass is now also mandatory for school and university staff, as well as university students. [https://www.thelocal.it/20210901/italys-green-pass-becomes-compulsory-on-long-distance-public-transport-from-wednesday/ (''The Local Italy'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria]]
*****The [[Australian state]] of [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] records 120 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the state's highest daily total in nearly a year. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-09-01/victoria-covid-cases-lockdown-melbourne-restrictions/100423686 (ABC News Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kiribati]]
****[[Kiribati]] says that it has now enough vaccines to immunize all its eligible citizens against COVID-19 after receiving a shipment of 90,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine]] donated by the [[People's Republic of China]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/450554/kiribati-govt-says-it-has-enough-doses-of-covid-19-vaccine-for-its-adult-population (RNZ)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
****[[Ontario]] will become the fourth [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Provinces of Canada|province]] to require proofs of vaccinations in restaurants, theatres, gyms and other indoor public venues. The vaccination certificate program will begin on September 22.  [https://apnews.com/article/lifestyle-canada-health-ontario-coronavirus-pandemic-25f590df3bb6ba612988d50d7da668d8 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Holy See relations]]
**[[Pope Francis]] defends the dialogue with [[China]] via the appointment of new [[Catholic bishops]]. Francis says that uneasy dialogue is better than no dialogue at all and compared the talks with China to those with Eastern European countries during the [[Cold War]]. The Vatican and China have had strained relations since the [[Communist Party of China|communist party]] took power in 1949. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/pope-defends-deal-with-china-says-dialogue-necessary-2021-09-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
***The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Department of Justice]] secures its 50th guilty plea in its [[criminal investigation]] of the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|January 6 riot]] at the [[United States Capitol]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/01/politics/capitol-riot-50-guilty-pleas-600-arrests/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
***Protests occur in front of hospitals across [[Greece]] to oppose [[COVID-19 vaccination in Greece|compulsory vaccination]] for [[healthcare worker]]s which takes effect today and could result in the dismissal of up to 10,000 unvaccinated workers. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/protests-in-greece-as-unvaccinated-health-workers-face-suspension (''Daily Sabah'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Prime Minister of Romania|Romanian Prime Minister]] [[Florin Cîțu]] dismisses [[Justice minister of Romania|justice minister]] [[Stelian Ion]], stating that he would "not accept ministers in the [[Government of Romania|Romanian government]] who oppose the [[Economy of Romania|modernisation of Romania]]." The removal creates a political crisis within the [[Cîțu Cabinet|coalition government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/romanian-pm-sacks-justice-minister-over-reform-response-2021-09-01/ (Reuters)]
